import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import label
A=np.array(grid)
for col in sorted(set(A.flat)-{2}):
    lab,n=label(A==col)
    comps=[]
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        pts=np.argwhere(lab==k)
        r0,c0=pts.min(0);r1,c1=pts.max(0)
        if len(pts)<25:
            sub=A[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
            comps.append((len(pts),(r0,c0,r1,c1),sub.tolist()))
    print(col,comps)
